subject: Re: Request — supplemental capacity & price alignment (Order Form update)
messages:
From: Ayla Thompson <ayla@zenhealth.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@zenhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplemental capacity request + pricing question

Hi Marissa,

We ran through a fresh forecast for Q3 and we expect peak inference needs to increase by ~45% for one of our fastest-growing verticals. Before committing to the runbook, procurement asked if we can get an add-on to the existing Order Form that: (1) adds 4x A100-equivalent GPU capacity for a 6-month window (start 2026-04-01), and (2) maintains current unit pricing for the baseline capacity but applies a blended rate on the incremental capacity.

Can you share the simplest path — a change order or amendment — and a redlined Order Form we can push to our legal team? We need an internal approval by 3/10 to hit our launch timeline.

Also added a Contracts alias on CC.

Thanks,
Ayla
Head of Platform
ZenHealth

Attachment: ZenHealth_capacity_estimate_Mar2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayla Thompson <ayla@zenhealth.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, contracts@zenhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental capacity request + pricing question

Ayla — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can absolutely support a 6-month supplemental pool and preserve your baseline pricing. For the incremental capacity, I propose a blended uplift of 12% on the per-token rate for the 6-month term (that keeps your quoted monthly spend predictable while covering burst capacity costs).

Next steps I’m proposing:
- I will send a draft Change Order (Order Form exhibit) with the capacity table and the blended rate.
- Jordan / Karthik, can Legal and Finance confirm the 12% uplift and flag any compliance notes (data-retention, audit logs) needed in the amendment?
- Ayla, if that uplift is acceptable we’ll send a redline for your counsel and include a DocuSign link for a sign-off path.

I’m attaching a working proposal (ChangeOrder_Proposal.xlsx) and will follow up with a redlined Order Form PDF by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ChangeOrder_Proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental capacity request + pricing question

Folks — looping Legal and a quick note from Finance.

Karthik: Marissa tentatively proposed a 12% blended uplift for incremental capacity (6-month term, effective 2026-04-01). Finance is okay with the uplift provided we: (a) limit liability change to existing MSA terms (no new indemnities), and (b) include explicit billing cadence and prorata language for the start/end of the 6-month window. Can you please prepare a one-page redline to the Order Form that:
- Adds Exhibit C (Supplemental Capacity) with the table from Marissa’s spreadsheet,
- Adds a clause for blended pricing and shows the formula,
- Confirms no change to data handling clauses in the MSA (we won't be adding new access rights), and
- Leaves the SLA unchanged.

Karthik — target: draft redline by EOD Wednesday so we can route to ZenHealth Contracts and get their approval before 3/10.

A couple of legal notes for ZenHealth Contracts (Ayla & contracts@):
- We will not change the MSA core (MSA remains governing agreement). This amendment will be an Exhibit/Order Form update.
- We will include audit-log retention language consistent with the current Order Form; if you need a longer retention window, note it and we’ll model cost impact.

Thanks — Jordan
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
